en.name: Mochi, freshly pounded
en.summary: Freshly pounded, unwrapped mochi is a same-day food and no room-temperature or refrigerated duration is published for it — the Japanese agriculture ministry gives methods rather than numbers. The traditional cold method is to keep it submerged in water, changed daily. Frozen, 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) is a reasonable window, read across from cooked rice.
en.pantry: Room-temperature storage is not recommended at all for unwrapped or homemade mochi, and no timeline is given for it. It moulds, and mould on mochi is worse than it looks: the visible fuzzy patch sits on top of a network that has already grown down into a soft, moist cake, so cutting the spot off does not make the rest sound. Freshly pounded mochi is a same-day food. Commercially packaged shelf-stable mochi is a different product with a printed date and is not covered here.
en.fridge: No refrigerated duration is published, only a method — and it is the traditional one, called mizumochi: submerge the mochi completely in room-temperature water in a lidded container, keep it in the fridge or a cool dark place, and change the water every single day. The water keeps air off the surface, which is what stops the mould. Skip a day and it goes cloudy and sour, and at that point it is finished. This is a method that asks for daily attention, which is precisely why the ministry recommends freezing for anything longer.
en.freezer: 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) is a reasonable working window, though it is borrowed from cooked rice rather than published for mochi — mochi is pounded cooked glutinous rice, so that is the closest read-across available. The recommended method is exact: wrap each piece individually in film, seal the pieces in a freezer bag, and freeze. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that; the limit is drying, cracking and freezer burn. Let a piece soften a little at room temperature before grilling or boiling.
en.thawing: Let a wrapped piece soften briefly at room temperature, or drop it straight into boiling water or onto a grill from frozen. Do not leave mochi out for hours to thaw — a moist, low-acid rice cake should not sit in the danger zone.
spoilage: Any mould at all — green, black, pink or white. Discard the whole piece; the growth runs deeper than the visible patch.
Cloudy, slimy or sour-smelling water in the mizumochi container.
A sour or fermented smell from the mochi itself.
Deep cracks and dry white patches on a piece kept too long in the freezer.
tips: Wrap each piece individually before freezing; a block freezes into something you cannot separate.
Change the mizumochi water daily without exception — this is the whole method.
Never trim mould off mochi and eat the rest.
Freshly pounded mochi is famously a choking hazard for children and older people; cut it small and serve it hot.

faq.q: How long does fresh mochi keep?
faq.a: It is a same-day food. No room-temperature or refrigerated duration is published; the traditional cold method is to keep it submerged in water with the water changed daily.
Yes, and it is the recommended way to keep it. Wrap each piece in film, seal in a freezer bag, and reckon on about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) — a figure read across from cooked rice.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off mochi?
faq.a: No. Mochi is soft and moist, so the growth runs far deeper than the fuzzy spot you can see. Throw the piece away.

zh.name: 現搗麻糬
zh.summary: 現搗、沒有密封包裝的麻糬是當天的食物，室溫和冷藏都沒有公布的可放天數——日本農林水產省給的是方法，不是數字。傳統的低溫作法是整塊泡在水裡、每天換水。冷凍的話，−18 °C 下抓 6 個月是合理的區間，這個數字是比照熟白飯來的。
zh.pantry: 對現搗或自製、沒有密封包裝的麻糬來說，室溫保存根本不被建議，也沒有給任何期限。它會長霉，而且麻糬上的霉比看起來更糟：你看到的那塊絨毛底下，菌絲早就往這塊又軟又濕的糕體裡長下去了，所以把霉點挖掉並不代表剩下的沒事。現搗麻糬就是當天吃的東西。超市那種密封、常溫的包裝麻糬是另一種產品，有印製日期，不在這一篇的範圍內。
zh.fridge: 冷藏沒有公布的天數，只有一個方法——而且是傳統的那個，叫「水餅」：把麻糬完全浸在常溫水裡、裝進有蓋容器，放冷藏或陰涼避光處，然後每天換水，一天都不能漏。水的作用是隔絕空氣，那才是霉長不起來的原因。漏換一天，水就會變濁發酸，到那個程度它就結束了。這是一個需要每天照顧的方法，也正因如此，官方才建議想放更久就直接冷凍。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下抓 6 個月是合理的工作區間，不過這個數字是從熟白飯借來的，不是為麻糬公布的——麻糬就是搗過的熟糯米，那是能找到最接近的對照。建議的做法很明確：每一塊單獨用保鮮膜包好，再一起裝進冷凍袋密封冷凍。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；限制它的是乾裂和凍燒。要吃之前先在室溫放軟一點，再去烤或煮。
zh.thawing: 包著在室溫放軟一下，或者直接從冷凍丟進滾水裡、放上烤網。不要讓麻糬在外面擺好幾個小時解凍——一塊濕潤低酸的米製品不該待在危險溫度帶裡。
spoilage: 只要長霉就整塊丟掉，不管是綠色、黑色、粉紅色還是白色；菌絲長得比你看到的深。
水餅的水變濁、發黏或聞起來發酸。
麻糬本身聞起來發酸或有發酵味。
冷凍太久出現深裂痕和乾白斑塊。
tips: 冷凍前每一塊單獨包好；整坨下去凍成一塊就分不開了。
水餅的水一定要每天換，沒有例外——那就是這個方法的全部。
絕對不要把麻糬的霉切掉之後繼續吃。
麻糬對小孩和長輩是有名的噎食風險，請切小塊、趁熱吃。

faq.a: 它是當天的食物。室溫和冷藏都沒有公布的天數；傳統的低溫作法是整塊泡水、每天換水。
可以，而且這是官方建議的保存方式。每塊用保鮮膜包好、裝冷凍袋密封，−18 °C 下抓 6 個月左右——這個數字是比照熟白飯而來。

faq.q: 麻糬長霉可以切掉再吃嗎？
faq.a: 不行。麻糬又軟又濕，菌絲遠比看得見的那塊絨毛長得深。整塊丟掉。
